findings.claim: The installer can overwrite files outside the harness directories when an existing generated-role path is a symlink.
findings.evidence: In `applyPlan`, each planned write does only `mkdirSync(path.dirname(w.to), { recursive: true }); copyFileSync(w.from, w.to);`; `planTarget` rejects symlinked export sources with `lstatSync(from).isFile()` but never `lstat`s the installed destination before writing. The acceptance criteria require the install script to copy only role files and refuse to touch non-team files.
findings.suggested_fix: Before copying, `lstatSync(w.to)` when it exists and refuse anything that is not a regular file; also validate target parent directories are real directories inside `root` rather than symlinks.
